title: LuckRead D1-04 W07 Subscription Renewal Cycles PostgreSQL Schema Slice

postgresMappings.integer: Use BIGINT for D1/SQLite INTEGER version, attempt and money-minor fields; retain exact safe-integer bounds where source requires them.
postgresMappings.time: Map ISO-8601 TEXT instants to TIMESTAMPTZ and compare as instants.
postgresMappings.json: Keep offer_snapshot_json and pricing_snapshot_json as TEXT with PostgreSQL JSONB object-shape checks.
postgresMappings.partialUnique: Preserve ux_subscription_renewal_cycles_payment as a partial unique index WHERE payment_id IS NOT NULL.
postgresMappings.relationships: Preserve source trigger-enforced logical relations to Order, OrderLine, Payment, SavedPaymentMethod and PaymentMandate; zero foreign keys.
postgresMappings.lease: SUBMITTING requires both lease_token and lease_expires_at; every other state has neither.
postgresMappings.mandate: A currently active provider-verified mandate and its matching saved method are required before PAYMENT_READY or SUBMITTING.
postgresMappings.outcome: Provider webhook/reconciliation owns terminal payment outcome; subscription sync state is separately versioned and never grants entitlement in D1-04.
postgresMappings.scheduler: The single seeded cursor row is schema control metadata only, not imported business data.
postgresMappings.authority: W07 owns D1-04 renewal/payment state; W10 owns only durable scheduling and retry orchestration.

requiredPositiveCases: new cycle starts awaiting authoritative pricing and scheduler seed cursor is present
pricing resolves once and immutable price/offer snapshots are preserved
cycle Order and Payment bindings match the subscription and commercial snapshot
matching currently-active HyperSwitch mandate permits PAYMENT_READY and SUBMITTING
valid leased submission reaches SUBMITTED then provider-confirmed SUCCEEDED
terminal provider outcome can be synchronized without granting entitlement
scheduler cursor advances through one-step version CAS
requiredNegativeCases: cycles cannot be inserted beyond AWAITING_PRICING or before authoritative pricing
duplicate subscription and period identity is rejected
resolved amount/pricing/method/mandate snapshots cannot be rewritten
order, order line, payment, subscriber, currency and amount mismatches are rejected
missing, pending, revoked or cross-customer mandate cannot authorize a charge
PAYMENT_READY cannot be entered directly from PREPARED without the active mandate
SUBMITTING without a lease is rejected and illegal state transitions are blocked
version must advance one step and updated_at must strictly increase
subscription outcome sync cannot run before a final cycle outcome
scheduler identity, CAS and timestamp are guarded
renewal cycle and scheduler control audit rows cannot be deleted

nextGate: PAY-004 local PostgreSQL 18 rehearsal only. RevenueCat inbox, refunds/billing and payment-method revocation remain separate slices. D1-04 remote runner and Neon cutover are not authorized.
